title: Tuhinga Riftn — Ngā Aratohu, Tohu, dApps & FAQ
description: Tuhinga whaimana a Riftn: tirohanga whānui o te tūāpapa, dApps, ōhanga tohu, tĭkanga, kēmu, mahere huarahi, FAQ me te maha atu.
body:
Ngā mea katoa e hiahiatia ana hei whakamahi, hei hono, hei hanga, hei whakawhānui i tō mātou pūhara. Mai i te aratohu tere ki te whirihanga taipitopito.

Tere me te pūmau

Hangaia ki runga i ngā mekameka haumaru rawa, tere rawa i L1 me EVM L2.

Haumaru

Ko ngā kaipupuri tōkena e whakahaere ana i ngā pona puta noa i te ao, e whakarato ana i te whatunga, e whiwhi ana i ngā utu.

Tautoko kaiwhakawhanake

Ka pūtea mātou i ngā kaupapa hapori me ngā kaupapa.

Hapori

He hapori kaha, tautoko mai i te tau 2021.
